subject: Q3 senior hire approvals — band allocations & cap request
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Q3 senior hire approvals — band allocations & cap request

Team —

Requesting approval to move forward with two senior leadership hires for Q3: Head of Model Ops (IC->Manager ladder, external hire) and Director, Customer Reliability (lead of platform reliability for Dedicated). This is time-sensitive because our pipeline and Dedicated capacity commitments hinge on headcount timing.

High-level ask: approve the hires at the proposed bands and release 2 headcount slots from the Q3 reserved cap (we currently have one discretionary slot left). Details attached (Q3_senior_hires_summary.pdf, comp_band_recommendations.xlsx).

Summary: 
- HoMO (L6): market target comp = $320k base + RSU range 0.25–0.4%, target total comp ~$420k; hiring manager: Marcus Lin (Platform).
- Dir, Customer Reliability (L5.5): market target comp = $240k base + RSU 0.12–0.2%, total comp ~$315k; hiring manager: Marissa Cole (CS/Operations).

Tradeoffs: If we keep the discretionary slot for product engineering, we delay Dedicated runbook ownership and risk SLA misses for commitments in July. If approved, we'll backfill an engineering role in Q4 (lower priority).

Please reply with approvals or objections by EOD Wednesday (Apr 7). If approved, HR (Soojin) will proceed with offer templates and compbench validation with CompBench.

Thanks,
Marcus
Marcus Lin
VP, Platform & Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs: Q3_senior_hires_summary.pdf (6 pages), comp_band_recommendations.xlsx (3 sheets)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q3 senior hire approvals — band allocations & cap request

Marcus —

Thanks for the summary. High level: I support the hires in principle because Dedicated commitments are strategic. Two quick asks before I formally sign off: 
1) Can you confirm the runway impact (headcount and cash) and whether we can absorb the full comp at midpoint vs. market top? Add a delta column to the comp spreadsheet showing budgeted vs. market.
2) For the HoMO, confirm whether internal L6 candidates exist (and if so, provide a short risk/benefit note on promoting internally vs. external search).

I'll try to get to formal sign-off once those two bullets are clarified. If HR flags anything (background checks, immigration), loop me in.

-Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
CEO, Redwood Inference

Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 11:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q3 senior hire approvals — band allocations & cap request

Folks —

I've attached an updated comp band workbook (comp_band_recommendations.xlsx) with the runway impact sheet Vivek asked for and a candidate/bench column for internal promotable folks. Quick notes: 
- Runway impact (assumes midpoints): adds ~$1.1M run-rate annualized (fully loaded) for the two hires; burn model updated in sheet 'RunwayDelta'.
- Internal promotion: we have one viable internal candidate (M. Ortega, Staff Engineer) for HoMO, but they're early on management experience; risk = longer ramp and potential backfill cost.
- Immigration: both roles flagged as likely needing US-based hires; if candidate needs sponsorship, add ~6–8 weeks and legal costs (estimate in sheet 'HiringCosts').

Requested approvals: 
- Release 2 headcount slots from Q3 reserved cap
- Approve proposed band midpoints for offer templates; HR will hold any top-of-market exceptions until written approval by Vivek/Finance.

If you want CompBench to run an external market survey for both roles, I can loop them in (cc'd).

Soojin Lee
Head of Talent Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: comp_band_recommendations.xlsx (updated), hiring-costs-memo.docx (1 page)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 13:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q3 senior hire approvals — band allocations & cap request

Quick thought: if we want to conserve Q3 cap, propose moving Dir, Customer Reliability to a contingent hire with a firm start in early Q4. That role's workload can be deferred by 6–8 weeks if we re-prioritize a small gating set of platform tasks. It reduces immediate cash impact and preserves a slot for a product engineering hire that will unblock a revenue feature.

If the business case for Dedicated SLA ownership is non-negotiable, lean toward approving both now. Either way, let's surface which revenue/ops risk is greater so we make an explicit trade.

- Aditya
Head of Product
Redwood Inference

Date: Tue, 06 Apr 2027 09:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q3 senior hire approvals — band allocations & cap request

All —

I reviewed the comp workbook and runway sheet. I am comfortable approving the two headcount releases conditioned on a small caps control: any top-of-market exception (above 90th percentile) must be routed to Finance and marked as 'exec exception' with a documented justification. Please add a 'ApprovalConditions' tab to the workbook and I'll sign off formally once added.

Also, Marcus — please add a one-paragraph hiring plan for the HoMO role that outlines interview panel, 8-week ramp expectations, and success metrics. That will help Talent and Hiring Managers move swiftly.

Laura Bennett
Head of People Operations
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Q3 senior hire approvals — band allocations & cap request

Thanks — all approvals captured. Per Laura's note I've added an 'ApprovalConditions' tab to the comp workbook and a one-paragraph HoMO hiring plan in the summary PDF. HR: please proceed with market checks via CompBench and prepare offer_template_senior.docx.

Decisions made: 
- Release 2 headcount slots from Q3 reserved cap: APPROVED by Laura (conditional), Vivek (conditional clarified), and Marcus (requester).
- Band midpoints approved for template use; any >90th percentile exceptions require exec sign-off.
- Dir, Customer Reliability to be prioritized for early Q3 hire; contingency plan to push to Q4 if final candidates require extensive negotiation.

Next steps: 
- Soojin to schedule compbench kickoff and share final market memo by Apr 12.
- Legal (cc'd) to prepare standard offer and check sponsor/immigration implications.
- Marcus to coordinate interview panel and target offer window of May 10–24.

Marcus Lin
VP, Platform & Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs: offer_template_senior.docx (1 template), Q3_senior_hires_summary.pdf (updated: 'HiringPlan' para added)
